verdict.rationale: Docs confirm some export capability — ASC 718 reports generate an Excel (.xlsx) file and scenario modeling can be exported — plus 'Standard reporting' is listed as a plan feature, but there is no explicit documentation of exporting the full cap table or complete transaction history to CSV/Excel on demand. missing for 10: explicit cap table CSV/Excel export feature, full transaction history export, any documentation guaranteeing unrestricted/anytime export ('never held hostage').
